svg.title: PCA on CIR: explained variance vs number of components
svg.desc: Line chart, cumulative explained variance (%) against number of principal components, 0 to about 1,016. The curve starts near 20% at the first component, rises steeply over the first few dozen components to just under 50%, then climbs steadily, crossing the 95% threshold at 848 components and the 99% threshold at 963, and reaches 100% at the last component.
